newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps steady, shine comes off gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps steady, shine comes off gasoline.

text.p: European oil swaps held broadly steady for the second day this week amid a slight tarnishing to the gasoline star.
Dealers said gasoline swaps eased off a touch as Brent crude CFDs gained a few cents. Fuel and naphtha were unchanged.
Gasoline swaps for August were assessed around $198.50-199.00, off $1 of so on better supplies of physical product from mid August onwards and talk of bearish API data later today.
Wet prompt barrels were talked around $203-204 with August physical discussed around $200 and under.
Brent CFDs were a few cents stronger with the balance of this week at +12 cents against September from +8 cents and August 4-8 firming to -6 cents against September from -7 cents.
August 11-15 was put at -11 cents against September from -13 cents and August 18-22 held at -20/21 cents.
Heavy fuel shifted sideways with August and September valued almost equal, September showing a 25 cent, possibly 50 cent contango. August was talked around $89.50-90.00.
Naphtha swaps were flat with August put at $190.00 with September still $2 backwardated.
Gas oil spreads were also steady with 4Q at $4.40-45, 1Q at $4.45 and 2Q at $4.00.
